concepts.quote: With a while loop the output is the same here, because 81 >= 70 is true at the start; it would only differ if i started below 70.
concepts.why: Correctly relates do-while to while: they behave the same unless the first test is false, which here only happens when i starts below 70, so the difference is the omitted first test.
Evaluates the loop condition with this code's initial value and gets the correct truth value, but gives no relation or purpose beyond that.
